title: Piplup • My First Bubble
description: A proud Piplup on a scalloped ice floe sends a rising chain of bubbles toward a curious orange fish. A curling turquoise tide wraps the floe; a waving flipper, enormous bright eyes, webbed feet and the dark blue penguin hood give the little Pokémon its unmistakable personality.
